definitions.explanation: north, south, east, and west; the four cardinal directions

examples.japanese: {四方|しほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{囲|かこ}まれている→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧。
examples.english: It is surrounded by mountains on all sides.

examples.japanese: {四方|しほう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いて→吹く：02445_fuku⟧くる。
examples.english: The wind blows from all directions.

examples.japanese: {四方|しほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見渡|みわた}す→見渡す：07169_miwatasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧しか⟦{見|み}えない→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Looking in all directions, I can see nothing but the sea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{四方|しほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{散|ち}らばった→散らばる：12713_chirabaru⟧。
examples.english: The enemies scattered in all directions.

examples.japanese: {四方|しほう}⟦{八方|はっぽう}→八方：06613_happou⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尽|つ}くした→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧。
{四方|しほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{目|め}を{配|くば}る→目を配る：30621_mewokubaru⟧。
examples.english: To keep an eye on everything around.

notes:
READING VARIANTS:
Also read as よも in some expressions like {四方|よも}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧ (seas all around; the world).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {四方|しほう}⟦{八方|はっぽう}→八方：06613_happou⟧ - all directions; every which way
- {四方|しほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧ - to surround on all sides
- {四方|しほう}{山|やま} - mountains on all sides (landlocked location)

RELATED DIRECTIONAL TERMS:
- ⟦{東西南北|とうざいなんぼく}→東西南北：22128_touzainanboku⟧ - the four cardinal directions
- ⟦{八方|はっぽう}→八方：06613_happou⟧ - eight directions; all directions
